cpu_usage_threshold_basis_points.description: Emit high-cpu when interval CPU utilization enters this basis-point threshold.

memory_available_threshold_bytes.description: Emit oom-risk when Guest available memory is below this byte count.

read_interval_threshold_bytes.description: Emit high-read when one process lineage exceeds this byte count in a collection interval.

write_interval_threshold_bytes.description: Emit high-write when one process lineage exceeds this byte count in a collection interval.

source_state_capacity.description: Maximum number of gateway/SB sources retained for OOM counter comparison.
